question: What is the total quantity ordered per customer in 2023?
gold_sql:
SELECT c."Name" AS customer_name,
         COUNT(l."SOLineNumber") AS line_count,
         SUM(NULLIF(l."Quantity", '')::numeric) AS total_qty
  FROM "tbl_sales_order" s
  JOIN "tbl_so_line" l ON l."SONumber" = s."SONumber"
  JOIN "tbl_customer" c ON c."Customer" = s."CustomerShipTo"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s."DateOrdered") = 2023
  GROUP BY c."Name"
  ORDER BY total_qty DESC NULLS LAST;

  ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST
